title: The Last Inheritance
author: Gideon Joubert
blurb: Noor Zhou, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
